name: me.jotis.regula
description: Sistema de diseño de la suite jotis.me

scripts.check:names: bun test scripts/check-package-names.test.ts && bun run scripts/check-package-names.ts
scripts.check:dev: bun test scripts/check-dev.test.ts scripts/check-changesets.test.ts scripts/check-commit-typography.test.ts && bun run scripts/check-dev.ts
scripts.check:ci: bun test scripts/ci-changes.test.ts scripts/ci-gate.test.ts scripts/check-ci.test.ts && bun run scripts/check-ci.ts
scripts.ci: biome ci --error-on-warnings . && turbo run typecheck test build
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && bun install && biome format --write packages
